d: Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney mocks US President Donald Trump during Canadian Parliamentary Press Gallery. Carney brings out a Trump impersonator during his speech. Firstpost takes a closer look at how Carney trolled Trump. Hem Kaur Saroya explains the current tensions between the US and Canada, including a stalled trade deal and a memo from US War Secretary Pete Hegseth telling American soldiers to reduce cooperation with their Canadian counterparts. HKS also examines the potential repercussions of Carney's comedy routine.
